'''Bertos Goodner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Posing as a dancer, he was in fact a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My friend. Welcome to Moenia. The starport is a bustling center of commerce and community. Shall I dance for you?|Bertos Goodner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
[[File:BertosDancing.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Bertos showing off his dance moves.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Bertos Goodner stood by the entrance of the [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] [[Moenia Starport|spaceport]] on Naboo. Posing as a dancer, Bertos Goodner would offer to dance for traveling [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who passed through the city. The Twi'lek preferred to dance at the spaceport rather than in the [[Moenia Cantina|cantina]] so he could gather more information from the travelers. In fact, Bertos Goodner was a member of the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] and the commander of the Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spies]] on Naboo.<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a Rebel spy named [[Simo Oron]] was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]] and detained in a small [[Imperial Base (Naboo)|Imperial Base]] in the [[Lasay Swamp]]. On [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Rebellion made arrangements to rescue Simo but his personal effects, including a sensitive contact list, were left behind. The Rebel droid [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] therefore tasked a group of Rebel operatives with obtaining his contact list in the Imperial base on Naboo. After the Rebel operatives succeeded in finding the contact list, they handed it over to Bertos Goodner in Moenia.<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bertos Goodner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Bertos Goodner was added to the game with the expansion ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', released on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. This NPC was originally a "greeter NPC": an NPC present at the entrance of a starport to provide general information to players arriving on a new planet.<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> Bertos Goodner was later integrated into a quest of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TSCL" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
